[S1] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Product sheet banana (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
• Phone se product ki 5–7 photos, alag angles, din ki roshni, flash off, details saaf. • Google Flow → New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro. • Saari photos upload/reference mein lagao → product sheet prompt chalao. • Sheet achhi na aaye toh dobara generate karo. Achhi sheet ko save rakho — poore course mein yahi reference hai.
Reviewed English translation: Take 5–7 clear phone photos from different angles in daylight, with flash off. In Google Flow choose New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro. Upload all photos as references and run the Product Sheet template. Review, regenerate if needed, and save the best sheet for later shots.

[S2] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Course overview and prerequisites (course-material) [Lesson 01; lesson_1]
Naam: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads (Skillomate). Format: Hinglish, chhote video lessons, ek AI presenter. Lessons: 8. Example product: white 60% compact mechanical keyboard, red accent keys, price ₹2,599 (sirf example). Kiske liye: jo apna product online bechte hain, aur jo dusron ke liye product ads banana chahte hain. Zarurat: phone, laptop, koi bhi product.
Reviewed English translation: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads has 8 lessons: 01 Course Intro; 02 Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (phone photos, Product Sheet, white studio/lifestyle/dark premium); 03 Model Ke Saath Product (character and product references, model shots and hands); 04 Festive Shoot + Colour Variants (Diwali, wedding scenes and a sheet for each colour); 05 ChatGPT Se Ad Plan (buyers, problems, angles, hooks, script, caption and Flow prompts); 06 Photo Se Product Video (one movement with Ingredients); 07 UGC-Style Video (honest phone-style AI-presenter videos); 08 Finale (complete workflow, common mistakes, honesty and final project). You learn to create product photos, product videos and honest ads for your own products or clients. You need a phone, laptop and a product. Tools: Google Flow, ChatGPT and CapCut; a full CapCut editing tutorial is not taught. Course prompts are in lesson notes.

[S3] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Prompts kahan milenge? (course-material) [Lesson 08; lesson_8]
Prompts kahan milenge? Saare prompts notes section mein hain (L08).
Reviewed English translation: The course prompts are available in the notes section.

[S4] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Model ke haath kisi aur ke lag rahe (course-material) [Lesson 03; lesson_3]
Model ke haath kisi aur ke lag rahe Prompt mein kapde/details character sheet se alag likhe hain. Match karo. (L03)
Reviewed English translation: Match the clothing and other appearance details in the prompt to the character sheet.

[S5] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Model ki ungliyan judi / extra (course-material) [Lesson 03; lesson_3]
Model ki ungliyan judi / extra "natural hands with five fingers" + dobara generate. Haath AI ke liye mushkil hain. (L03)
Reviewed English translation: Add “natural hands with five fingers” and regenerate. Hands are difficult for AI; inspect the fingers before using the image.

[S6] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Kya AI model ko customer review (course-material) [Lesson 07; lesson_7]
Kya AI model ko customer review Nahi. AI insaan asli grahak nahi hai — ise review/testimonial bata ke bata sakte hain? mat chalao. Product dikhane ke liye use karo. (L07)
Reviewed English translation: Do not present an AI actor as a real reviewing customer. Use an honest product demonstration or UGC-style showcase without claiming genuine customer experience.
